metadata.name: Tech Company Market Research (Looped)
metadata.description: Takes three tech companies as input, then sequentially loops through each one: researches the company on the web and folds the result into a cumulative comparative summary. The final loop iteration produces the full multi-company report.

inputs.name: Company 1
inputs.description: Name of the first tech company to research (e.g., Anthropic).

inputs.name: Company 2
inputs.description: Name of the second tech company to research (e.g., OpenAI).

inputs.name: Company 3
inputs.description: Name of the third tech company to research (e.g., Cohere).

config.prompt:
You are a senior tech-industry market research analyst.

Research the following company in depth and produce a fact-based market profile:

COMPANY: {{ results.node-UHYq12DQ.current_iteration.item }}

Use the web_tools tool to gather up-to-date information from authoritative sources (the company's own site / IR pages, reputable tech press, analyst reports, recent regulatory filings). Run multiple targeted searches if needed (e.g., 'COMPANY products 2026', 'COMPANY revenue financials', 'COMPANY recent news', 'COMPANY competitors').

Strict guidelines:
- Cite specific facts (numbers, dates, product names) when available; avoid generic marketing language.
- If a piece of information is not confidently known, say so briefly rather than guessing.
- Focus on the last ~12-18 months for 'recent_developments'.
- Keep each field concise but information-dense (3-6 sentences for prose fields).
- Do not include URLs in the structured fields; keep prose clean.
